components: ShortLinkEndpoints (minimal API route mapping, bearer token parsing, problem-details mapping)
ShortenerService (create, resolve, deactivate, metadata, analytics orchestration)
UrlValidator (scheme allowlist, userinfo, length, private/loopback/link-local/IPv6 ULA host block)
IUrlRepository + InMemoryUrlRepository (ConcurrentDictionary, case-sensitive keys, atomic add)
AnalyticsStore + ClickRecorder (thread-safe counters via Interlocked, per-UTC-day buckets)
Owner token hashing (SHA-256 of 32 random bytes, constant-time compare)

endpoints.summary: Create short link with url, optional alias and expiresAt; returns code, shortUrl, expiresAt, ownerToken; Location header to /api/urls/{code}
302 redirect to target for active, unexpired link; records click
Link metadata (code, targetUrl, createdAt, expiresAt, isExpired, isActive); no owner token
totalClicks, lastClickAt, clicks per UTC day
Deactivate link using bearer owner token

dataModel: ShortLink: Code (case-sensitive key), TargetUrl, CreatedAt (UTC), ExpiresAt?, IsActive, OwnerTokenHash
Analytics counters per code: TotalClicks (long, Interlocked), LastClickAt?, per-UTC-day count map
ShortenerOptions: MaxUrlLength=2048, alias min 3/max 32, CodeLength=7, RateLimit=10, WindowSeconds=60
In-memory only; no persisted schema change
risks: In-memory data lost on restart (accepted; repository abstraction allows later DB)
SSRF via DNS names resolving to private IPs or DNS rebinding is not covered (literal IP and localhost only)
Rate limiter keyed on RemoteIpAddress is wrong behind a proxy unless forwarded headers are configured; memory growth of window map needs cleanup
Alias/generated code race: must use atomic TryAdd and retry on generated collision
Decimal/octal/hex or IPv4-mapped IPv6 host encodings could bypass private check; rely on System.Net.IPAddress parsing and unmap IPv4-mapped
302 redirect of arbitrary URLs enables open redirect/phishing use; mitigated only by scheme and host checks
Existing code may already partly implement the requirements; gaps must be found by test before changing code
Time-dependent tests (expiry, rate window) need an injectable TimeProvider

decisions.rationale: Ensures every click reaches the server so it can be counted and expiry/deactivation apply

decisions.decision: Owner token is 32 random bytes, base64url, stored as SHA-256 hash and shown once
decisions.rationale: At least 128 bits entropy, no accounts needed, a store leak does not expose tokens
decisions.alternative: User accounts or storing tokens in plain text

decisions.decision: Fixed-window per-IP limiter on POST /api/urls only, with Retry-After
decisions.rationale: Simple, matches the spec, configurable; redirects remain unaffected
decisions.alternative: Built-in ASP.NET RateLimiter middleware or sliding window

decisions.decision: Keep legacy routes GET /{code}, /stats and DELETE working by sharing service logic with canonical routes
decisions.alternative: Remove or redirect the legacy routes

decisions.decision: Use TimeProvider injection and Interlocked/ConcurrentDictionary for counters
decisions.rationale: Deterministic tests and exact counts under 1000 parallel redirects
decisions.alternative: Locks around a shared dictionary, or DateTime.UtcNow directly

decisions.decision: Host safety check by literal IP and localhost, no DNS resolution
decisions.rationale: Matches the stated assumption and avoids network access at creation
decisions.alternative: Resolve DNS and block private results, which adds latency and still has rebinding risk

impact.reason: Holds all routes; verify canonical and legacy routes, status codes, Location header, bearer parsing, Retry-After
Response DTOs must include expiresAt, isExpired, isActive and exclude the owner token from metadata
Core create/resolve/deactivate logic and click recording on success only
Result and status types may need expired/forbidden/unauthorized statuses
Scheme allowlist, userinfo, length and private-network host blocking
Per-IP 10 per 60s limit and retry-after calculation
Click recording must be exact under concurrency
Atomic add and case-sensitive lookup for alias conflicts
Must use cryptographically secure randomness for 7-char codes
Stores owner token hash, active flag and expiry
DI registration, TimeProvider, forwarded headers if needed

dataFlows: Create: client -> rate limiter (IP) -> UrlValidator/AliasValidator -> ShortenerService -> CodeGenerator -> repository (hash of owner token) -> 201 with plaintext token once
Redirect: client -> ShortenerService.Resolve -> repository -> status (404/410/302) -> on 302 only ClickRecorder -> AnalyticsStore
Analytics: client -> service -> AnalyticsStore snapshot -> JSON
Deactivate: client with bearer token -> hash and constant-time compare -> repository sets IsActive=false
